stories.title: WKYC, S.H.I.N.E. team up to support Laura's Home Women's Crisis Center in Cleveland: How you can donate to help this holiday season
stories.summary: From Nov. 16 to Dec. 12, WKYC and S.H.I.N.E. are teaming up to support Laura's Home Women's Crisis Center in Cleveland.

stories.title: 'Will never be forgotten' | Cleveland police mourn death of Larry, beloved member of Mounted Unit
stories.summary: Larry was partnered with Officer Dugan of the Mounted Unit throughout his years of service.

stories.title: Forest City Cleveland launches Northeast Ohio's first MLS NEXT Elite Academy, led by longtime St. Ignatius soccer coach
stories.summary: The forthcoming pro soccer club Forest City Cleveland will launch an MLS NEXT Elite Academy in fall 2027, led by longtime St. Ignatius coach Mike McLaughlin.

stories.title: 21-year-old man arrested following deadly crash involving RTA van in Cleveland
stories.summary: A 21-year-old man was arrested in connection with a deadly Cleveland crash that killed a 73-year-old RTA van passenger.

stories.title: Clyde community mourns 17-year-old student-athlete killed in Sandusky County crash; brother hospitalized
stories.summary: William "Wint" Keegan was remembered as a hardworking teammate and friend. His younger brother, Wyatt, was critically injured, according to a family fundraiser.

stories.title: Winning Powerball numbers for the $76 million jackpot on Monday, Nov. 16, 2026: See all the prizes hit in Ohio
stories.summary: The jackpot now jumps to $92 million for the next drawing later this week.

stories.title: OHSAA soccer championships: Avon beats Brecksville-Broadview Heights in PKs to win D-II boys title; Hudson claims D-II girls crown
stories.summary: Avon's boys team beat Brecksville-Broadview Heights in the 11th round of PKs at the OHSAA soccer championships, while Hudson's girls squad capped a perfect season.

stories.title: Ohio State pulls away in 2nd half to beat Prairie View A&M 86-59
stories.summary: Justin Pippen scored 12 of his 14 points in the second half, Jimmie Williams had 11 of his 13 before halftime, and Ohio State beat Prairie View A&M 86-59.

stories.title: North Ridgeville City Council approves tougher distracted driving penalties months after road worker was badly injured in crash
stories.summary: North Ridgeville has voted to toughen its distracted driving penalties after a road worker's severe injuries, spurring debate over Ohio's laws.

stories.title: Perry Local Schools in Stark County to reopen Tuesday following 'cyber incident'; some tech access to remain 'limited'
stories.summary: Classes at Perry Local Schools will resume tomorrow following an unspecified 'cyber incident,' though some technology usage will remain limited.

stories.title: 40 years later, families fight to keep Akron students' killer behind bars as parole hearing looms
stories.summary: Clinton Dickens — who kidnapped, raped, and murdered Wendy Offredo and Dawn McCreery in 1986 — is up for parole. Their families are hoping he stays behind bars.

stories.title: Cleveland Public Power customers to see rate increases starting in 2027 after City Council approval
stories.summary: Cleveland Public Power customers will begin paying higher rates in January.
